title: Time Tunnel
build: U.S. Gold disk, 1985 (C64 Preservation Project G64, time_tunnel[us_gold_1985](!), SHA-256 6bfb0bb1...2d2fc9); the program T1, $0900-$C5FD, is the same bytes on the collection's alternate dump

credits.role: help with the development (the title screen)

accuracy.note: 60 of the 391 hand-written comments (12 wrong) and 20 of the 179 generated from the object tables (2 wrong, a template, corrected in all 89 it wrote)

exclude: the game's variables: zero page and $0200-$08AC, cleared by the start-up and written in play
the end of the fast loader FL, loaded at $0845-$0CBC and partly overwritten by T1; left in memory, and nothing in the game reads it
built at run time: the start-up's copy of the character ROM ($E000-$EFFF, with the sprite buffers at $EC00-$EDFF) and the era's character set unpacked at $F000
free RAM above the screen, and the hardware vectors the start-up writes at $FFFA-$FFFF
